_comment: Retrieval test set for the BMW owner manual (chapters 'Displays' and 'Wheels and tires'). gold = list of groups; each group lists acceptable sections as 'Section title@page'; a group is hit when any of them is retrieved. multi_hop = the full answer needs more than one section. style 'manual' = worded like the manual, 'user' = paraphrased like an owner would ask. Written by hand from the manual text; extend with real user questions.
